description.value: This study investigates the relationship between brain activity and interindividual variation in subjective affect ratings during a standardized positive mood induction in healthy participants.

spans.text: This study investigates the relationship between brain activity and interindividual variation in subjective affect ratings.

description.value: A standardized mood induction procedure was applied to healthy participants during fMRI, with subjective affect ratings collected before and after the mood induction.

spans.text: A standardized mood induction (MI) procedure, using positive facial expression and autobiographical memories, was applied to 54 healthy participants (28 female), who rated their subjective affective state before and after the MI.
